entries.title: Abiotic Factor

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original Early Access route and remains the best high-end capture/settings platform after the 1.0 launch. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S launched with 1.0 and cross-play, but they do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Steam version on Windows PC for the most flexible route. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are good alternatives if a console or subscription route is preferred.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC 1.0 release on Steam after the 2024 Early Access period.
all_releases.reason: primary: original development route and best capture/settings platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 release alongside 1.0 with online co-op support.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S release alongside 1.0 with Game Pass access and cross-play support.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console/subscription route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: All launch platforms received the 1.0 release path with cross-play, while PC remains the highest-flexibility capture/settings platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: The July 22, 2025 release is the 1.0 launch after Early Access, not a remaster. Console versions are same-era ports rather than separate editions.
